b2fd5caf6e.why: The byte comparison, mask transfer, pointer decrement, and observable upper-vector clearing all require separate instructions.

98b7f5ea12.why: The mask in k0, trailing-zero count in rax, and final comparison flags are all required, leaving no redundant instruction.

f44b1df2e2.why: The comparison mask, its copy in rax, the rdi advance, and mask-dependent ZF are all required outputs.

fdabc827aa.why: The unmasked comparison in k0, independently required 64-bit prefix mask in rcx, and final AND result and flags prevent collapsing the mask construction into a direct BZHI.

22f340c712.why: The comparison mask, shifted rcx, masked rax, and final AND flags are all required outputs.

c114d51c05.why: SSE2 needs both MOVD and PUNPCKLBW to form the required xmm1 value, while the ecx copy and rdx zero test produce independent required outputs.

08cc769ae6.why: The two SSE2 vector operations produce the required repeated byte-pair pattern, and both the ecx mask and comparison are needed to preserve rcx, CF, and ZF.

aedf62dc97.why: Preserving xmm1 while producing xmm0, rax, and ZF requires the load, destructive SSE2 comparison, mask extraction, and scalar test.

4331c65d28.why: Advancing and aligning rdi and masking ecx are necessary, and folding the rdx addition and subtraction into LEA would lose the required subtraction CF and ZF.

48aafa068a.why: The required xmm0 comparison result, rax mask, ZF, and unchanged xmm1 leave no removable operation in this SSE2 sequence.

ed9dff6d9e.why: The load and destructive comparison are needed to preserve xmm1 and produce xmm2, while mask extraction and TEST separately produce rax and the required flags.

37cb4de682.why: The load and destructive comparison are needed to preserve xmm1 and produce xmm3, while mask extraction and TEST separately produce rax and the required flags.

92496b00b2.why: The xmm4 comparison, rax mask, pointer advance, and TEST flags are all required, and SSE2 cannot fold away the load while preserving xmm1.

8a461cb06b.why: The xmm3 comparison, rax mask, pointer advance, and TEST flags are all required, and SSE2 cannot fold away the load while preserving xmm1.

8a93190ea2.why: Splitting the arbitrary input rdi into its aligned base and six-bit offset, then adding that offset to rdx, requires all four operations at the permitted ISA level.

41f9f717c3.why: All four vector outputs, including the intermediate comparison masks and accumulated masks, are required, and SSE2 still needs mask extraction plus a scalar test to produce ZF.

4a8642ebd9.why: The two distinct byte-comparison results in xmm3 and xmm1, the extracted rax mask, and the TEST flags are all required.

45ae8abc6b.why: The edx update is required, and SSE2 needs separate loading, comparison, mask extraction, and testing while preserving xmm1.

5dc74c7d1e.why: Comparing two memory vectors requires a load and comparison, while the required incremented rax mask and ZF need the extraction and INC.

97e0617b89.why: The two memory operands require separate loading and comparison, and preserving the incremented rax mask and ZF requires both VPMOVMSKB and INC.
